# Vijay Ravichandran

> Freelance AI engineer & technical architect based in Munich, Germany, with 10+ years building production-grade machine learning systems for global companies and high-growth startups. Expert in speech recognition (ASR), generative AI, small language models, and scalable cloud infrastructure. Available for freelance projects.

## Availability

- **Available for freelance and consulting work** in applied AI, speech technology, and technical architecture.
- Based in Munich, Germany; works with clients across Europe and remotely.
- Contact: vijay@ravic.dev

## Services

- Speech & voice AI (ASR, voice interfaces, language modelling)
- Generative AI & local-first small language models
- AI strategy & technical architecture
- Cloud & ML infrastructure (CI/CD, evaluation pipelines)

## Projects

- **LaLeTu** (/projects/laletu) — Production reading-fluency platform powered by speech recognition; helped thousands of students and won "Startup of the Year, Hessen 2024". Acting CTO / Speech Engineering Lead.
- **Bixby — German** (/projects/bixby-german) — Trained language models to bring Samsung's Bixby assistant to German, including dialects; built BERT-based usage analysis. Senior Speech Recognition Engineer.
- **Text-to-Singing** (/projects/text-to-singing) — Generative prototype turning text into melodic vocal performances; became the foundation for a company spin-off. Machine Learning Expert.
- **AI for Scientific Simulations** (/projects/ai-for-scientific-simulations) — Independent research applying neural networks to scientific simulations to improve researchers' existing models.
- **Local-First Small Language Models** (/projects/local-first-slms) — Independent research into low-latency SLM architectures for privacy-focused, local-first environments.
